activeAdultUseRetailStoresSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report (December 31, 2025): retail-store line of the 343 total active adult-use establishments (retail + cultivator + manufacturing + testing). Refreshed annually when OCP publishes its annual report.

currentOcpLicenseeRoster.source: OCP Adult-Use Establishments and Medical-Use Registrant CSVs via scripts/ocp/fetch-ocp-towns.py (live deduped storefront counts)
currentOcpLicenseeRoster.note: Two parallel facts are intentional. The 180 figure on stat cards is the 2025 Annual-Report total of active AU retail-store establishments. The dated July 8, 2026 live roster records 106 deduplicated AU Store entries in 51 municipalities and 269 deduplicated caregiver storefronts in 116 municipalities. These sources use different dates and definitions and must not be conflated.

dataSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report (stat-card facts) + OCP Adult-Use Establishments and Medical-Use Registrant CSVs fetched 2026-07-08 (dated live-roster facts).
nextRefresh: Annual-report fields refresh when OCP publishes its annual report (typically Q1 the following year). OCP-CSV fields refresh monthly via `node apps/maine-cannabis/scripts/ocp/refresh-site-stats.cjs` when OCP publishes new CSVs.
notes: Single source of truth for OCP retail-store figures across the site. Preserve the Annual Report and dated live-roster definitions when updating consumers.
